title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: every location is listed, whatever your enrollment
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B}, an "Admin" user enrolled only at {Location-A}, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-11 One Place; {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in this report at {Location-A} and {Location-B} on today's date; {Location-B} had none on {Date-A}.
    For example: {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310; {Date-A} is a date before {Location-B}'s first open bill.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has open documents only at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-11 Home Only.
  • Starting screen: A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Location chip and read the list.
  2. Close the menu.
  3. Look at the rows' Location column.
  4. In the Vendor filter, tick {Vendor-A}.
  5. Click the Location chip and read the list.
  6. In the Past due filter, tick "1-30 days".
  7. Click the Location chip and read the list.
  8. In the Location menu, untick {Location-B}.
  9. Close the menu.
  10. Click the Location chip again and read the list.
  11. Change the as-of date to {Date-A}.
  12. Click the Location chip and read the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both {Location-A} and {Location-B} are listed and ticked, although you are enrolled only at {Location-A}.
  • Step 2: the menu closes.
  • Step 3: rows from {Location-B} are shown too: the report stays organization-wide.
  • Step 4: only {Vendor-A}'s rows remain.
  • Step 5: both locations are still listed: the list is not narrowed by the Vendor filter.
  • Step 6: the chip reads "Past due: 1-30 days".
  • Step 7: both locations are still listed: the list is not narrowed by the Past due filter.
  • Step 8: {Location-B} is unticked.
  • Step 9: the menu closes.
  • Step 10: {Location-B} is still in the list, unticked: the list is not narrowed by the Location filter.
  • Step 11: the report reloads for {Date-A}.
  • Step 12: the list changes with the as-of date: {Location-B} is no longer offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R3: “the Location list is not narrowed by the Past due filter either.”
  • S5-R12: “The filter does not change who can see what: everyone who can open these reports sees every location's data, as today.”
  • Out of Scope: “Restricting these reports by the user's location enrollment. The reports stay organization-wide for everyone who can open them today; the Location filter only narrows. Any enrollment-based restriction would be its own announced permissions change.”
  • Key Decisions, organization-wide: “The reports stay organization-wide, by decision. Everyone with access sees every location's data, as today; the Location filter only narrows. Rationale: no permission changes in this release (decided 2026-10-15). Rejected: restricting the reports to the locations a user is enrolled in, which would be its own announced permissions change later.”
  • Goals: “Nobody gains or loses access to any data, and no setup is needed.”
